out='/tmp/owner.rar'
uu.decode(src,out,quiet=True)

print(b[:8])

def read_var(buf, off):

    comp=zlib.crc32(hdr)&0xffffffff

    print(' id',hid,'flags',hex(flags),'after header fields rel',p-o)

    if hid==1:
        if flags&1:
            ed,el=read_var(b,p); p+=el; print(' main extra_data_size',ed)

        if flags&1:

        vals=[]
        for name in ['file_flags','unpacked_size','file_attr','compression_info','host_os','name_size']:
            v,vl=read_var(b,p); p+=vl; vals.append((name,v,vl))
        print(vals,'name',b[p:p+vals[-1][1]],'p',p)
        p+=vals[-1][1]
        endhdr=o+4+hdr_size
        print('extra bytes rel',p-o,'to endhdr',endhdr-o,b[p:endhdr].hex())
        q=p
        rem=ed if flags&1 else 0
        while q<endhdr:
            fs,fsl=read_var(b,q); q+=fsl
            fid,fil=read_var(b,q); q+=fil
            print('  extra field size',fs,'id',fid,'qrel',q-o,'body',b[q:min(endhdr,q+fs)].hex())
            q+=fs # maybe size excludes size/id? unclear
    o = o+4+hdr_size
    # skip data maybe for file block data_size

        o += ds
        del ds
    n+=1
